comment: Written for this version (not in the original game): epilogue pages shown after the ending message, loosely based on the novel Dragons of Autumn Twilight. Edit freely; keep each page under 150 characters.
complete: Through the dark roots of Sla-Mori the Companions carried the war into Pax Tharkas. Laurana lives, and the fortress stands empty behind you.
The women and children of Qualinesti are free. They stream south into the mountains, away from the dragon armies' grasp.
But the Highlords are not so easily robbed. Dragons wheel in the northern sky, and winter is coming early to Krynn.
The blue crystal staff has stirred old hopes, and a doddering old mage named Fizban hints at stranger allies.
Beyond the mountains lie the great city of Tarsis and a war that spans all the world. Your journey is only beginning...
incomplete: You have escaped the evil fortress of Pax Tharkas, but not everyone was so fortunate. Those left in its towers will feel the Highlord's wrath.
The dragon armies still hold the high passes, and the war for Krynn goes on. Perhaps the Companions will find a way back before winter...
